claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Digoxin at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, since cardiac glycoside Na+/K+-ATPase inhibition requires higher concentrations or longer exposure to kill most cancer lines and no class in the vocabulary captures its killing pattern.
